routes.owner_boundary: Task owner and process owner
routes.activation_rule: New task, changed scope or re-entry.
routes.failure_disposition: Stop on missing owner, inactive type or unsafe capacity.
routes.classification_reason: Changes control state and selects the first executable stage.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ Agent and Product Truth owners
routes.activation_rule: Entry or re-entry requires current facts and sources.
routes.failure_disposition: Return to source collection or verification; do not infer facts.
routes.classification_reason: Transfers work through the Product Truth chain.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ owner with Product Truth boundary
routes.activation_rule: A product entity and buyer job must be evidence-bound before ideation.
routes.failure_disposition: Investigate conflicts or collect evidence before Content TZ.
routes.classification_reason: Controls transition from product evidence into content planning.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ owner and decision owner
routes.activation_rule: Only when a decision relies on competitor evidence or AI recommendation.
routes.failure_disposition: Monitor or investigate; never convert competitor observation into our claim.
routes.classification_reason: Requires a typed research branch and conflict-preserving reducer, not a universal sequential edge.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ owner and relevant diagnostic owner
routes.activation_rule: Ambiguous search/GEO scope or risk to established demand.
routes.failure_disposition: Route non-content gaps to their owners; stop when demand preservation is unresolved.
routes.classification_reason: Selects an owner or blocks a phrase; it does not itself transfer production work.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ and phrase-decision owner
routes.activation_rule: Every new product phrase, including localization.
routes.failure_disposition: Reject, observe or return for fact validation; never place unsupported phrase.
routes.classification_reason: Constrains content fields across existing nodes without creating a new stage.

routes.owner_boundary: Market Intelligence and Commercial/Category owner
routes.activation_rule: New positioning, audience split or value story.
routes.failure_disposition: Stop with consumer evidence gap; do not invent persona.
routes.classification_reason: Needs an external evidence-producing branch before reduction into Content TZ.

routes.owner_boundary: Task owner and failure-stage owner
routes.activation_rule: AI-shopping or catalog failure is the task trigger.
routes.failure_disposition: Only content gaps enter Content TZ; retrieve/transaction defects route elsewhere.
routes.classification_reason: Classifies the problem before graph entry rather than producing content.

routes.owner_boundary: Measurement or SEO owner; human disavow approver
routes.activation_rule: Visibility anomaly or backlink/disavow proposal.
routes.failure_disposition: No major change while incident remains unresolved; disavow requires human approval.
routes.classification_reason: Belongs to SEO/measurement incident handling and only re-enters core as a new content task.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ Agent and process owner
routes.activation_rule: Applicable evidence checks are complete and content investment is being decided.
routes.failure_disposition: No brief for maintain, retire, investigate or unjustified investment.
routes.classification_reason: Controls whether authoring proceeds and its bounded rework loop.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ Agent and process owner
routes.activation_rule: Authorized content task requires testable, claim-bound deliverables.
routes.failure_disposition: Return incomplete hypothesis, claim, channel or owner decision.
routes.classification_reason: Produces and freezes the execution contract consumed downstream.

routes.owner_boundary: Local verifier and receiving human
routes.activation_rule: Before handoff or controlled action.
routes.failure_disposition: Block on failed deterministic or semantic evidence checks.
routes.classification_reason: Supplies acceptance gates at several real transfers rather than a single isolated policy note.

routes.owner_boundary: PPC owner and authorized human
routes.activation_rule: Only an explicitly linked PPC change.
routes.failure_disposition: No live PPC action or authority inheritance from Content TZ.
routes.classification_reason: Separate commercial execution profile outside product-content production.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ Agent to runtime-resolved Prompt Agent
routes.activation_rule: Approved production contract, launch control and AGENT_RESOLVED_READY receipt exist.
routes.failure_disposition: Return ambiguity or stale dependency to its owner; runtime resolution permits one reload before recoverable block.
routes.classification_reason: Transfers the approved brief into a verified callable execution-specific compiler under explicit launch scope.

routes.owner_boundary: Runtime Resolver, Prompt Agent, AI Creator and Production owner
routes.activation_rule: AI generation or material edit is selected and the Prompt Agent has AGENT_RESOLVED_READY.
routes.failure_disposition: Return to defect owner, reload once, recoverably block, rollback or bounded retry; never silently drift invariants.
routes.classification_reason: Defines the core AI production and repair path with verified agent callability.

routes.owner_boundary: Content Standard Auditor and localization owner when applicable
routes.activation_rule: Any completed asset or localization.
routes.failure_disposition: Route execution, concept or fact defect to its actual owner and recheck affected output.
routes.classification_reason: Owns real output acceptance and typed targeted rework.

routes.route_name: Humanity and genericity for trust-stakes copy
routes.owner_boundary: Copy executor and named human owner
routes.activation_rule: AI-assisted copy within defined trust-stakes scope.
routes.failure_disposition: Targeted rework, evidence return or reject; N/A must have reason.
routes.classification_reason: An applicability-dependent QA overlay, not a universal workflow stage.

routes.owner_boundary: Creator-task owner and named approver
routes.activation_rule: Creator or affiliate material connection exists.
routes.failure_disposition: Correct missing disclosure/evidence before release.
routes.classification_reason: Conditionally constrains affected assets without creating a general production node.

routes.owner_boundary: Receiving human and process owner
routes.activation_rule: Before cost-bearing continuation, test or release.
routes.failure_disposition: Keep asset unpublished while release or measurement contract is missing.
routes.classification_reason: Contains explicit human-controlled transition points.

routes.owner_boundary: Experiment Analyst and process owner
routes.activation_rule: After a real test or observation.
routes.failure_disposition: Record bounded result; never auto-promote learning into Product Truth or standard.
routes.classification_reason: Post-release learning lifecycle is outside the current production graph.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ and changed-source owners
routes.activation_rule: Product Truth, claim, rights, policy, channel or promotion validity changes.
routes.failure_disposition: Supersede affected downstream artifacts and re-enter at the earliest invalidated stage.
routes.classification_reason: Controls deterministic invalidation and re-entry.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ and validation-route owner
routes.activation_rule: Conversational audience model influences positioning or creative.
routes.failure_disposition: Keep as hypothesis until real Voice-of-Customer validation.
routes.classification_reason: Needs a typed evidence branch; it cannot be treated as Product Truth.

routes.owner_boundary: Analytics, implementation and business owners
routes.activation_rule: A decision or experiment depends on event analytics.
routes.failure_disposition: Block metric use until semantic contract is complete.
routes.classification_reason: Analytics implementation is outside content-production runtime.

routes.owner_boundary: Implementation, Analytics and Business owners
routes.activation_rule: Conversion event is used for decision or test.
routes.failure_disposition: No scale, stop, budget shift or causal claim below trusted state.
routes.classification_reason: Validates measurement evidence after external instrumentation.

routes.owner_boundary: Receipt owner, Analytics and Business owners
routes.activation_rule: Cross-channel purchase signals are compared.
routes.failure_disposition: Block ranking, scaling and causal learning when signals are non-comparable.
routes.classification_reason: Cross-system analytics control does not execute content production.

routes.owner_boundary: Analytics, Experiment and Business owners
routes.activation_rule: Applicable sequence, intent-transition or mix-shift condition is present.
routes.failure_disposition: Keep descriptive or thin evidence as hypothesis only.
routes.classification_reason: Conditional analytics methods require their own measurement runtime.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ, Experiment Analyst and Content/Business owner
routes.activation_rule: Video selection depends on title or cover promise.
routes.failure_disposition: Revise package or stop on promise mismatch.
routes.classification_reason: Adds video-specific requirements to existing authoring, QA and release nodes.

routes.owner_boundary: Passport Verifier, Content TZ, Production and release owners
routes.activation_rule: Product discovery asset uses identity, feature, benefit, suitability or comparison.
routes.failure_disposition: Return stale facts, variant conflicts or missing proof to their owner.
routes.classification_reason: Binds concepts to Product Truth across existing stages.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ owner, Auditor and human release owner
routes.activation_rule: Two or more independent functions share one immutable decision object and parallelism has benefit.
routes.failure_disposition: Preserve missing branches and conflicts; HOLD cannot be overwritten by OK.
routes.classification_reason: Requires explicit branch nodes, reducer edges and conflict-preserving fan-in semantics.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ, Prompt Agent, AI Creator, Auditor and process owner
routes.activation_rule: Material generation/edit, paid provider call or scaled run.
routes.failure_disposition: Stop before provider call on missing bounded authority, adapter, entrypoint, credentials, capability, price, reference mode or remaining call/cost limit; video stays blocked without callable video adapter.
routes.classification_reason: Existing provider execution edges are the concrete implementation of this bounded run contract.

routes.owner_boundary: Sender, receiver, Auditor and process owner
routes.activation_rule: Handoff, checkpoint, fan-in/out or authorized asset transfer.
routes.failure_disposition: Stop on tampering, unauthorized egress, credential misuse or trajectory mismatch.
routes.classification_reason: A cross-cutting transfer invariant applied to many edges, not another hop.

routes.owner_boundary: Lineage owner, Product Truth Verifier and Auditor
routes.activation_rule: AI output is proposed for reuse, memory, examples, template, corpus or next generation.
routes.failure_disposition: Restrict or revalidate intended use; synthetic output never creates a product fact or test win.
routes.classification_reason: Controls reuse of produced artifacts rather than primary production flow.

routes.owner_boundary: Sender and receiving node owner
routes.activation_rule: Pause, blocker, owner/stage change, context reset or costly mode switch.
routes.failure_disposition: Remain blocked until context and side effects are reconciled.
routes.classification_reason: Exactly represented by checkpoint and resume edges.

routes.owner_boundary: Dependency owner, Prompt Agent and template reviewer
routes.activation_rule: Reusable skill/provider/tool is used or Prompt Agent compiles from approved Content TZ.
routes.failure_disposition: Revalidate stale dependency; require reason and review for a new template.
routes.classification_reason: Constrains dependency selection inside existing compilation and preflight nodes.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ, price/offer owner and release owner
routes.activation_rule: Content explains premium, comparison or economic value.
routes.failure_disposition: Stop false comparison or unsupported saving; agent cannot change price.
routes.classification_reason: Adds claim and authority constraints to existing content stages.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ, Carousel Compiler, Prompt Agent, Auditor and human owner
routes.activation_rule: Carousel, slideshow or editorial batch is requested.
routes.failure_disposition: Rework missing/distorted payload; render is not approval or publication.
routes.classification_reason: Needs a registered Carousel Compiler or explicit mapping to an existing compiler before runtime.

routes.owner_boundary: Comment Intelligence, Content TZ, Auditor and human/product/support owner
routes.activation_rule: Comments are proposed as evidence for brief, FAQ, reply video or angle test.
routes.failure_disposition: Route safety/support/product issues; isolated comment cannot become creative input.
routes.classification_reason: Requires typed clustering/provenance output before Content TZ can consume it.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ, Listing owner and Passport Verifier
routes.activation_rule: Quantity variation, multipack or buyer-facing quantity promise is created or changed.
routes.failure_disposition: Return facts to verifier or eligibility to current marketplace review; no automatic listing update.
routes.classification_reason: The content check applies in core, but listing mutation remains external and human-controlled.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ, Experiment Analyst, SKU, Finance/Commercial and release owners
routes.activation_rule: Seasonal or promotion brief assumes delayed purchase intent.
routes.failure_disposition: Collect evidence or redesign test; only Finance/Commercial approves offer.
routes.classification_reason: Depends on promotion authority and bounded test outside core production.

routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ, Retrieval/Search, SKU, Runtime and release owners
routes.activation_rule: Content targets conversational, search, related-question or agent-facing retrieval.
routes.failure_disposition: Route retrieval/product/runtime defect to its owner; copy cannot mask system defect.
routes.classification_reason: Core creates and QA-checks the asset, while surface runtime test remains external.

routes.route_name: Brand message and media execution controls
routes.owner_boundary: Content TZ/marketer, Prompt Agent, executor, Auditor and release owner
routes.activation_rule: Substantive content optimization or media execution activates the applicable brand, proof, fidelity, channel and processing controls.
routes.failure_disposition: Return evidence, fidelity or platform defect to the responsible owner; QA never substitutes release.
routes.classification_reason: A conditional bundle of standards applied across existing nodes, not a standalone transition.
